use default

let limit = 130_000
let largest_prime_factor = LIST(limit + 1)
let is_cubefree = LIST(limit + 1)

for _ in 0::limit do
    largest_prime_factor.add(1)
    is_cubefree.add(true)
od

for candidate in 2::limit do
    if largest_prime_factor[candidate] == 1 then
        let multiple mut = candidate

        while multiple <= limit do
            largest_prime_factor[multiple] = candidate
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od

        if candidate <= limit / candidate / candidate then
            let cube = candidate * candidate * candidate
            let cube_multiple mut = cube

            while cube_multiple <= limit do
                is_cubefree[cube_multiple] = false
                cube_multiple = cube_multiple + cube
            od
        fi
    fi
od

let sequence = (1::limit)
    |> filter(n => is_cubefree[n])
    |> map(n => largest_prime_factor[n])
    |> collect_list()

write_line("first 100 terms:")

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells = (0..10) |> map(column => "{sequence[row * 10 + column],4}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

for n in [1_000, 10_000, 100_000] do
    write_line("term {n,7}: {sequence[n - 1]}")
od
